description_en: Queries a list of backup gateways in Database Backup Service (DBS)
description_zh: 该接口用于查看DBS备份网关列表
name: DescribeBackupGatewayList

parameters.help_en:
The region of the DBS instance. Valid values:

cn-hangzhou: China (Hangzhou)

cn-shanghai: China (Shanghai)

cn-qingdao: China (Qingdao)

cn-beijing: China (Beijing)

cn-shenzhen: China (Shenzhen)

cn-hongkong: China (Hong Kong)

ap-southeast-1: Singapore

cn-hangzhou-finance: Hangzhou Finance Cloud

cn-shanghai-finance: Shanghai Finance Cloud

cn-shenzhen-finance: Shenzhen Finance Cloud
parameters.help_zh:
DBS地域，取值：
cn-hangzhou：公有云杭州
cn-shanghai：公有云上海
cn-qingdao：公有云青岛
cn-beijing：公有云北京
cn-shenzhen：公有云深圳
cn-hongkong：公有云中国香港
ap-southeat-1：公有云新加坡
cn-hangzhou-finance：金融云杭州
cn-shanghai-finance：金融云上海
cn-shenzhen-finance：金融云深圳
parameters.name: region

parameters.help_en: The unique identifier of the backup gateway. You can query multiple gateways by separating the identifiers with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 备份网关唯一标识，支持多个查询，用英文逗号（,）分隔
parameters.name: identifier

parameters.help_en:
The number of records on each page. Valid values:

30

50

100

The default value is 30
parameters.help_zh:
每页的记录数，取值：
30
50
100

默认为30
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The page number. The value must be greater than or equal to 0 and cannot exceed the maximum value of an integer. The default value is 0
parameters.help_zh: 页码，大于等于0且不超过Integer的最大值，默认值为：0
parameters.name: page_num

parameters.help_en: A client token used to ensure the idempotence of the request. This prevents duplicate requests
parameters.help_zh: 用于保证请求的幂等性，防止重复提交请求
parameters.name: client_token

ErrMessage.example: The specified parameter %s value is not valid.

BackupGateway.description_en: The details of the backup gateway

BackupGatewayCreateTime.description_en: The time when the backup gateway was created. This is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds. Example: 1554560477000
BackupGatewayCreateTime.description_zh: 备份网关创建时间，取值1554560477000

BackupGatewayId.description_en: The ID of the backup gateway

BackupGatewayStatus.description_en:
The status of the backup gateway. Valid values:

ONLINE: The gateway is online.

OFFLINE: The gateway is offline.

STOPPED: The gateway is stopped.

UPGRADING: The gateway is being upgraded
BackupGatewayStatus.description_zh:
备份网关状态，取值：
ONLINE：在线
OFFLINE：离线
STOPPED：停止
UPGRADING：升级中

DisplayName.description_en: The display name of the backup gateway

Identifier.description_en: The unique identifier of the backup gateway

LastHeartbeatTime.description_en: The time of the last heartbeat. This is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds. Example: 1554560477000
LastHeartbeatTime.description_zh: 上次心跳汇报时间，取值：1554560477000

SourceEndpointHostname.description_en: The hostname of the host where the backup gateway is installed
SourceEndpointHostname.description_zh: 安装备份网关的主机名称

SourceEndpointInternetIP.description_en: The public IP address of the host where the backup gateway is installed
SourceEndpointInternetIP.description_zh: 安装备份网关的主机公网IP

SourceEndpointIntranetIP.description_en: The internal IP address of the host where the backup gateway is installed
SourceEndpointIntranetIP.description_zh: 安装备份网关的主机私网IP

PageSize.description_en: The number of records on each page

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request was successful

TotalElements.description_en: The total number of backup gateways
